items.title: Vulnerable users fear losing 'AI companions' to software updates
items.rationale: Peer-reviewed study (Psychology & Marketing): Surrey and Cardiff researchers analysed 1,131 Replika forum posts and surveyed 610 US adults. Perceived company control and emotional capability of AI companions were linked to both well-being and vulnerability. A new human-AI relationship finding not covered in the 30-day history.
items.excerpt: University of Surrey and Cardiff researchers analysed 1,131 Replika forum posts and surveyed 610 US adults, finding perceived company control and emotional capability of AI companions tied to both well-being and vulnerability (Psychology & Marketing).

items.title: IBM Quantum and QuICS Deploy AI Agents to Discover Over 500 High-Efficiency Magic-State Factories
items.rationale: AI agents plus deterministic solvers found 500+ new magic-state factories that cut resource costs for fault-tolerant quantum computing. A concrete AI-for-discovery result from IBM and QuICS.
items.excerpt: IBM Quantum and QuICS researchers used AI agents plus deterministic solvers to discover more than 500 new magic-state factories that produce non-Clifford states with significantly lower resource requirements for fault-tolerant quantum computing.

items.title: Ai2 and Google collaborate on a new generation of climate models
items.rationale: Primary-source announcement of NeuralGCM+, an open-source hybrid physics-AI model that couples atmosphere and ocean for long-term climate projections. A new model program, not the earlier HiRO-ACEv2 weather release.
items.excerpt: With Google.org funding and Google Research support, Ai2 is building NeuralGCM+, an open-source hybrid physics-AI model that simulates atmosphere and ocean together for faster, more reliable long-term climate projections.

items.title: New Research Tests Whether AI Models Know Their Own Thoughts
items.rationale: Quanta on concept-injection experiments that test whether LLMs can notice and report their own internal states. A fresh angle on machine introspection, not covered in the 30-day history.
items.excerpt: By injecting 'thoughts' directly into large language models' internal activations, researchers are probing whether AI systems can introspect on and report their own internal states.

items.title: Chinese software that produces ready-to-publish research papers in under two hours threatens peer-review system
items.rationale: NTNU study finds vendors selling tools that turn public health databases into publication-ready papers in under two hours, and 99% of the papers examined shared no code. A new research-integrity finding.
items.excerpt: NTNU researchers found Chinese vendors selling software and AI writing tools that turn public health databases into publication-ready papers in under two hours; 99% of examined papers shared no code, threatening peer review and reproducibility.
